scenes.title: 2006 Paris NeuroSpin Lab: Dialing a 50-ms Mask Past the Tipping Point Triggers 300-ms Frontoparietal 'Global Ignition'!
scenes.era: 2006, NeuroSpin (Saclay) & Collège de France, Paris, France

layout.description: Sunlit high-key 2006 French cognitive-neuroimaging gallery featuring a precision **visual-masking stimulus display** flashing a target word across **16 ms -> 33 ms -> 50 ms -> 83 ms**, a studio-white **translucent 3D human brain model** showing **local occipital conduction (<200 ms)** transitioning cleanly into **restrained internal white-matter tract conduction linking parietal and prefrontal hubs (~300 ms)**, and Dehaene's **3-State Taxonomy & All-or-None Step-Curve Board (Subliminal | Preconscious | Conscious Ignition!)**.

positions.who: Stanislas Dehaene (mannequin in 2006 French academic dark blazer and open-collar crisp shirt)
positions.where: standing beside the 3D translucent brain and Nonlinear 300-ms Step-Curve pointing to the exact 50-ms threshold where flat unconscious processing leaps into full frontoparietal broadcast!

positions.who: Observer mannequin (in 2006 high-density MEG/EEG cap seated before the visual-masking monitor)
positions.where: shaking head 'Blank screen!' at 33-ms masking while visual cortex quietly lights — then pressing 'I SEE IT!' at 50+ ms as the 300-ms frontoparietal workspace unifies!

props.name: visual-masking threshold monitor (33 ms Unseen vs 50+ ms Seen) + Nonlinear 300-ms Step-Function Board
props.period_detail: captures Del Cul & Dehaene's exact phase-transition discovery

props.name: studio-white 3D Brain Workspace Model (Local V1 Wave vs Coherent Internal Prefrontal-Parietal Tract Pulse)
props.period_detail: renders Global Ignition with museum-clean restrained internal fiber conduction per R53

actions.verb_sequence: advances the mask delay from 33 ms (local occipital pulse fades at ~270–300 ms a smooth restrained internal pulse conducts along long-range parietal-to-prefrontal white-matter tracts -> Observer reports the word aloud!

reactions.reaction: marvels that their visual cortex read the word 33 ms ago without 'them' ever knowing until the 300-ms broadcast hit
maps Subliminal, Preconscious, and Conscious Access onto one testable architecture

scenes.recognition_hook: Flash a word with a 33-millisecond mask and your visual cortex reads it while YOU swear the screen was blank — nudge the mask past 50 milliseconds, and at 300 milliseconds a sudden frontoparietal wave broadcasts 'I SEE IT!' across your entire brain!

key_visual.description: a sunlit 2006 Paris neuroimaging gallery where Stanislas Dehaene points to a 3D brain model's restrained internal frontoparietal white-matter tracts and a nonlinear 300-ms step-function board beside a masked-word observer
